title: Plan Safe Fault Experiments
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Plan Safe Fault Experiments.
learning_objectives: Explain plan safe fault experiments using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for plan safe fault experiments
Assess failure and operational limits of plan safe fault experiments
concepts_covered: A hypothesis-first experiment has a measurable healthy baseline, a bounded fault, and an explicit stop/recovery plan.
Dry run is default; local executor is a host-side demo; scheduler and real infrastructure executor are absent.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
